**How to submit:** Upload your WAV file and your answers (a photo of your paper or a document) to the university e-learning platform. Due: **before lecture 8**.
No task needs AI.

## Task 1 · Your sound effect

Choose one sound for a game: a coin, a door, a jump, a splash, a button
click. Record it with Audacity or a free recorder app.

a) Record three takes. Write the settings you used (sample rate, channels)
and the peak level of your best take.

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) Clean your best take: trim, fade-out, then normalize to −1 dB. Write the
steps you did, in order.

{{< answer-space lines=3 >}}

c) Export it as a WAV, 16-bit, mono, with a good name (for example
`sfx_coin_01.wav`). Upload the file.

## Task 2 · Channels and formats

a) Why do you record your sound in mono and not in stereo?

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}

b) The game also needs a 2-minute background music. Which format do you
choose for it, and why?

{{< answer-space lines=2 >}}
